Take an adoptable dog out to the beach, a park or a cafe; photos help them get adopted. Apply via the doggy-day-date application (Shelterluv form linked on the page). Shelter at 10405 Southern Blvd, Royal Palm Beach, open to the public 11am-5pm daily; second site in Loxahatchee. Age/cost not stated.
